title: Losing the Pete Lala job and joining Octave Crosby at the Tuxedo
summary: A new six-piece band took over Pete Lala's, and Russ landed at the Tuxedo nightclub with Octave Crosby and Father Allen.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
